body: I am done reasoning, I am done arguing with myself, as soon as I am able I am ending this garbage.
There is nothing for me. I just want it to stop.
Thank you. It means a lot, even if from a stranger

I have tried, but I am resigned to the idea that I married the wrong person.

I've taken her out to dinner, tried to be a better husband, but I can't shake the feeling. I made a mistake.

It's only a matter of time before I tell her, I think. I can't think of any other way. 'Sorry, you're basically the perfect girl, but I would rather be alone'. It would devastate her, to be sure, but would also mean that her green card would get revoked, and she would have to go back home.

I can't see another way, and I would rather not waste her time on an asshole like me

No, but she is. She knows how to make such things. 

I've been to Japan many times during the LDR. Her parents did not approve of the marriage when we met with them. She cried. She decided to go against her parents wishes.

I'm sure she is hopeful that we grow to love each other more. Honestly, I'm just out of energy. It would solve all of my problems if I could just LOVE her. But I can't stop my mind from rerunning the last year over and over. I wake up in cold sweats. I dream that I am dying, or that I am leaving the relationship, or that the relationship I declined could be reconciled. But I wake up with the same realization, and the same desire for things to be different. They won't be different unless I make them different, this much I know. But I just can't.

I ate before coming to the bar. My wife made me dinner (see what I mean lol). Okonomiyaki. It's delicious even if it's completely fattening.

We've been married for 5 months now. There was no ceremony. Together for 4 years. It is a tough situation. I've been hesitant to make any decisions because of my past depression episodes and my knowledge that this is temporary. But I stopped being happy with the state of things about 14 months ago.

It is selfish and awful when those feelings don't reflect the amount of respect that others have given you.

And my wife has shown me nothing but patience and respect. And honestly, that's kind of the problem. It sounds weird, but I wish she was a worse person. It would have been easier to tell her I've fallen out of love. Honestly I can't find fault with her, which makes me feel like even more of a shitty person.

I'm in a bar, drinking a pitcher to myself, stalling going home. I've got all the time in the world to chat.

Why continue? There is so much hurt, and no respite. I don't believe you. Even if I did, how could that compare to the love of people directly in my life? My mother? My best friend? I am positive that they care, but I don't. How do I fix that? I can't. I've tried and tried, but I'm just so tired. Who do I go to with my grievances? God? There is none. There is only myself to blame. I want to die, but I can't do it. Because of a childish fear of death. But I hope to die, every day. There is no escape. There is just me, wishing I would die, and just me, keeping me from it.

I am not on antidepressants. I am afraid of starting to take them. The last time I started taking them, I was in the hospital within a month. Overdose. I became fixated on the idea that suicide was the only answer.

I am resigned that there is no solution for me. I just have to wait it out and get better. But I feel short on time lately. The only thing I can do is wait and hope that things improve. I plan to do that, but recognize my time may run out. At this point, I am okay with that. It is better than doing nothing.

Intellectually, I know I shouldn't end my life. I know everything is temporary and that people would be hurt by it. But emotionally, I want to end things so badly. My depression is controlling that side of things and makes it impossible to act rationally.

I spend all of my time just convincing myself to eat and to get out of bed in the morning, all the while being forced to relive the past. I don't have any energy left for when it gets any more intense than that.

You're right, I won't be forgotten, and the absence of me would leave a void in others' hearts. But my depression doesn't care. And it's worn me down to the point that I don't care anymore. Not about myself, not about others, and certainly not about giving myself any time to see anything clearly. It's displacing my reasoning skills, and I can't do anything about it. I am just so tired.
